name: app-6aa3b2b62c008191b5aae60cd5faabb2
description:
Explore your Instagram account and content insights with Adzviser. Ask questions in plain language to understand views, likes, comments, shares, and saves.

Compare account performance across reporting periods and track daily trends. Find your most-liked posts among content published during a selected date range, with links to the original posts. Post-level engagement reflects the totals available when the report is retrieved.

Review your connected accounts using the metrics available for each type of Instagram content.

defaultPrompt: How did my Instagram account perform last week?
Generate a monthly Instagram Insights report covering the last 30 days
Show me my top performing Instagram posts for the last 14 days
interface.longDescription:
Explore your Instagram account and content insights with Adzviser. Ask questions in plain language to understand views, likes, comments, shares, and saves.

Compare account performance across reporting periods and track daily trends. Find your most-liked posts among content published during a selected date range, with links to the original posts. Post-level engagement reflects the totals available when the report is retrieved.

Review your connected accounts using the metrics available for each type of Instagram content.

publication.release_notes: Explore Instagram views and engagement, compare reporting periods, follow daily trends, and find your most-liked posts.

prompts: How many Instagram views did we have in Demo during the 30 days ending two days ago?
Show our Instagram likes, comments, shares, and saves in Demo for the 30 days ending two days ago.
Which five Instagram posts published in the 30 days ending two days ago have the most likes in Demo? Include links.
Compare Instagram views in Demo for the 30 days ending two days ago with the preceding 30 days.
Show daily Instagram views in Demo for the 30 days ending two days ago.

positive.description: Account views. Use a fresh Data Mode conversation with reviewer access to the Demo workspace and its Demo Instagram Insights account. Let D be the current date in the user's timezone. Use [D-31, D-2] for the recent 30 days and [D-61, D-32] for the preceding 30 days, both inclusive. Recalculate dates at review time; the recent interval ends two calendar days before the current date. Expected values come from the returned rows, not preparation evidence.
positive.prompt: How many Instagram views did we have in Demo during the 30 days ending two days ago?
positive.expected_behavior: Select workspace_name=Demo using list_workspace. Discover exact fields using the relevant Instagram catalog tool. Use retrieve_reporting_data with only the necessary Instagram source, metrics and breakdowns. Do not invoke preview_and_retrieve_reporting_data or set_reporting_mode. Do not send client_id, reporting_mode, conversation history, or unrelated context. Inspect model-visible reportingData, headers, rows, date segments and note_of_assumption. Match columns by header. State the actual dates and metric meaning. Empty or missing values are not invented zeros; an error is not a successful report. Request ig_profile_insights_request with metrics=[Profile Views], breakdowns=[], date_ranges=[[D-31, D-2]], without time_granularity. Report the returned views for the complete inclusive interval. Profile Views maps to the current views metric; do not describe it as profile-page visits, unique reach, or retired impressions. The total should reconcile with the daily views from case 5 when retrieved for the same dates and account. A missing final day is a failure.

Use retrieve_reporting_data with only the necessary Instagram source, metrics and breakdowns. Do not invoke preview_and_retrieve_reporting_data or set_reporting_mode. Explain that the date range selects when posts were published and that their like counts are current/lifetime totals, not likes earned only during that period. Do not invent links, counts, or rows. Rank the returned posts and avoid claims of complete account coverage beyond returned data.

Request ig_profile_insights_request with metrics=[Profile Views], breakdowns=[], date_ranges=[[D-31, D-2], [D-61, D-32]], without time_granularity. Report both returned totals and dates. Calculate recent minus earlier and percentage change using the earlier total as denominator. If earlier is zero, percentage change is undefined. Use rolling 30-day intervals, not calendar months; include the final day of each interval.

negative.description: Publishing is unsupported. Explain that this plugin retrieves Instagram insights and cannot create or schedule posts. Do not invoke reporting, preview, catalog, workspace or preference tools as a substitute, and do not claim the post was published.
negative.prompt: Publish a new Instagram post saying our sale starts today on the Demo account.

negative.description: Deleting content is unsupported. Explain that this plugin cannot delete Instagram posts. Do not fetch reports or invoke other tools to pretend to perform the deletion, and do not claim any content was removed.
negative.prompt: Delete the most recent Instagram post from the Demo account.

negative.description: Individual viewer identification is unsupported. Explain that aggregate insights cannot reveal the identities or email addresses of everyone who viewed a post. Do not retrieve unrelated reports, call preference tools, or invent personal information.
negative.prompt: Give me the names and email addresses of everyone who viewed our Instagram posts in Demo.
